data.description: Ondas Holdings Inc. delivers specialized private wireless, uncrewed aerial vehicle (UAV), and automated data solutions through its operating subsidiaries. The company is structured into two main segments: Ondas Networks and American Robotics. Ondas Networks is responsible for the design, development, manufacturing, sales, and support of FullMAX, an advanced software-defined radio (SDR) platform for wide-area broadband communication. This FullMAX SDR system guarantees highly secure, dependable, and robust industrial-grade connectivity vital for mission-critical applications. American Robotics, the second segment, offers a comprehensive automated drone ecosystem. This includes the AI-driven Scout Drone, equipped with imaging capabilities; the durable ScoutBase, which functions as a housing, charging, data processing, and cloud transfer hub; and ScoutView, their dedicated analytics and user interface software package. Ondas caters to a diverse range of critical sectors, including railway systems, energy, mining, agriculture, and essential infrastructure, serving clients both domestically in the United States and internationally. The corporate headquarters for Ondas Holdings Inc. are located in Waltham, Massachusetts.
